2026-07-25: this file used to build the FOUNDRY-CELL reference. That was
PLAN.md phase 2's deliberate fallback, but nothing ever wired the all-own
build into the submission path, so the fallback was what a paid submission
would have bought — a die with sky130_fd_sc_hd rings and a foundry-cell
CORDIC, both CI badges green and the zero-foundry claim false.
See research/vertical-slice-presubmit-codex.md (blocker 1).
THE FIX: the TT flow now places and routes the ALL-OWN netlist. It has to
be the TT flow that does it — harden/config.json produces a BARE DIE (no
IO placement, no PDN, no tile template), so handing TT that artifact would
not be a valid tile. Here TT supplies floorplan/pins/power and the keys
below supply the cells.
TO REVERT to the foundry reference (phase 2's fallback, if the all-own
path runs out of road before a deadline): delete the ALL-OWN block below,
restore "VERILOG_DEFINES": ["USE_HD_CELLS"], and set info.yaml's
source_files back to the four .sv files. One commit, no other coupling.
Synthesis already happened in flow/make_hardening.py and the netlist is
COMMITTED (harden/vslice_gates.v, referenced from info.yaml). CI does P&R
only, so the netlist that gets audited is the netlist that ships — and the
own-cell mapping recipe (dfflibmap on own_hardening.lib, abc on
own_abc.lib, hilomap TIE_X1) is not something the stock flow would apply.
The sources are a gate netlist, not RTL: the linter has nothing useful to
say about it, and ERROR_ON_NL_ASSIGN_STATEMENTS trips on legal netlist
assigns. Both are off for the same reason in harden/config.json.
Corner-aware timing views (ported from harden/config.json, itself ported
from stdcells at lib-v1.1). hd libs ride along per corner because the flow
still loads hd views; EXTRA_EXCLUDED_CELLS is what keeps hd cells out of
the netlist. flow/check_corner_spread.py asserts the SDF corners really
differ, which catches a nominal view silently overriding LIB.
THE zero-foundry lever: without this the flow quietly inserts hd tie
cells, hold buffers, CTS buffers and fill, and the claim dies.
Every special cell must be one of ours, for the same reason.
A fast library makes hold OVERFIX expensive: default margins x a 171 ps
BUF_X2 produced 322 repair buffers = 27% of logic area and an infeasible
placement. 0.005 is the measured working value (stdcells, then harden/).
85 is the measured working density for these cells; the TT template
default of 72 was tuned for hd. Raise if GPL-0302 appears.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz. Ship clock is 25 MHz; the
all-own build measured 10.5 ns of setup slack at this period.
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
